title: Joint ALT–GGT nonadditivity gives no clear gain in cross-sample CRP prediction
abstract: Among adults20+ without known pregnancy and CRP≤10mg/L, NHANES2005–2006 to2007–2008 transfer of a centered logGGT×logALT term beyond additive flexible enzyme/anthropometric predictors gave Brier improvement 0.00012860 (95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00046746 to 0.00060330) for CRP>3mg/L; no clear incremental evidence.
